description: One WANDR-shaped eval task the estate's own research runs can be scored against (GO list item 6, corpus/steal/MASTER_MICKEY17_V2_20260924.md). Each member is one real, estate-relevant research claim carried in the MICKEY-17 v2 master fold; each required field is a facet a research run must establish with a cited page record; each record cites one url whose excerpts must be verbatim on that page. Graded by re-fetching each cited page, then rolled up with WANDR soft/hard precision/recall/F1 (https://arxiv.org/html/2608.14747v1).
shape_note: Members: 10 (WANDR released median is 100; scaled to seed width per the GO row). Required records per member: 3.00, equal to the WANDR median. Records per task: 30 (WANDR median 245). Per-level count floors below are enforced by the loader; a parent short of its floor is a task error, not a scoring event.

record_shape.url: page the record cites (http, https, or file scheme)
excerpts: verbatim excerpts that must appear on the cited page
record_shape.answer: the extracted value the record asserts

members.claim: WANDR's scoring protocol grades each record by re-fetching its cited page and rolls verdicts up the hierarchy into soft (partial-credit) and hard (complete-member) precision/recall/F1.

fields.requirement: The paper's own definition of the soft vs hard precision split.

excerpts: Soft precision gives partial credit to incomplete members; hard precision assigns credit only when a submitted member’s required subtree is fully correct.
records.answer: soft = partial credit to incomplete members; hard = fully correct subtree only

fields.requirement: The paper's failure-localization taxonomy over the task tree.

excerpts: Failures can be localized across the tree: a system may fail to discover core task entities or members, enrich intermediate entities or keys, identify relevant pages, extract adequate evidence from those pages, or disambiguate identities when keys collide

fields.requirement: The estate action line that adopts the protocol (the citation-P/R spec extension this tool implements).

excerpts: Extend the librarian citation-P/R spec (DAY_PACK.md:2901) with the soft/hard split and zero-padded recall against per-level required counts; grade by re-fetching each cited page; report both F1s per run.
